parsed.study_design: Qualitative assessment using structured field observations and interviews
parsed.population_and_sample: Ten primary schools in Rumphi town; 23 students with disabilities, 11 teachers, and 2 local government representatives
parsed.exposure: Implementation and enforcement of national disability-inclusive WASH policies and standards, including school management, maintenance, budgeting, monitoring, staff training, and consultation practices
parsed.outcome: Accessibility and availability of school drinking-water and sanitation facilities for students with disabilities, including physical barriers, reliability, privacy, cleanliness, coping strategies, and exclusion
parsed.rationale: The Methods section (pp. 762–763) identifies the population, study design, observations, interviews, and qualitative/descriptive analysis.
